title: 2013 White House rumours of 'confirmation, not disclosure'

tellings.quote: You get to Vallée's most recent journals, he documents early in 2013 rumors coming out of the White House. And these rumors are essentially saying they're planning to do something called confirmation, not disclosure.

plain: In early 2013, rumours from the White House said the government was planning something called "confirmation, not disclosure": admitting the phenomenon is real without revealing everything about it. A researcher named Jason Simosa says this is recorded in the latest published journals of Jacques Vallée, a scientist who has studied UFOs for decades, where Vallée writes down the rumours he heard. Simosa raises it as a sign that a limited, managed admission was being planned from the top.
